analysis_implementation_review.claim: New optional parent panels do not change existing scoring or default checkpoint plots; parent reference is the same-count/same-seed frozen L best.

interpretation: The first S200 seed inherits most of its performance from LoRA. Further F3 training reduces boundary-band error on this seed, while incremental AbsRel and F1 effects relative to the actual L best parent remain uncertain. A same-endpoint comparison against the degraded L final model would greatly overstate the incremental improvement. Wait for the other seeds; preserve both endpoints and full parent cost.
